variants.candidate: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth makes it steady, so what you learn sinks in. As a catalyst, nothing settles for long, and you work it out alone rather than lean on anyone. You judge best once you give a question its night.

variants.original: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Fire makes it fuel, so demands shape you. As a catalyst, nothing tests you, so you want a crisis as much as a rank to keep. You get most done under rules someone else set.

variants.original: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Metal makes it hard, so your will holds. Running thin, strength gives out, so you stand alone rather than lean on a peer and bet big rather than rest. You last longest once you let rest and company in.
